description_sq:
Shitet toke ne nje prej zonave me te deshiruara te Tiranes, ne Mullet prane rrethrrotullimit.
Toka ka nje siperfaqe prej 1200m2 dhe ka forme kuadratike te shfrytezueshme. E pershtatshme per ndertim vilash ose ambjente komerciale.
Toka disponon hipoteke eshte nje mundesi shume e mire investimi.
Per me teper informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
description_en: Land for sale in one of the most desired areas of Tirana, in Mullet near the roundabout. The land has a surface of 1200m2 and has a usable square shape. Suitable for building villas or commercial premises. The land has a mortgage, it is a very good investment opportunity. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us.
